title: Rescaling the inner product
statement: Let $u,v:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and let $A,B\in\mathbb R$ be nonzero. With expectation and inner product taken under the uniform measure on the Boolean cube, $\langle u,v\rangle=AB\,\mathbb E[(u/A)(v/B)]$.
hypotheses_covered: $u$ and $v$ are real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
replaced: Let $u,v:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ and nonzero $A,B\in\bbr$, uniform expectation satisfies $\E[uv]=AB\E[(u/A)(v/B)]$.
